title: The Lion's Spirit Lives On - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: The Lion's Spirit Lives On trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: The Lion's Spirit Lives On phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A hidden boss tied to the Memory Flower count, which is why flower collection is not optional on a completionist run.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 9 of 36 on the list - before it Will We Meet Again? · after it Sword Against the Seven-Stars. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
